Do you prefer to drive around on your reachtruck all day? Do you also want to work full-time? Apply as a reach truck driver at Lekkerland in Waddinxveen. A job for a longer period with a good chance of a permanent contract at Lekkerland. Yes! Don't miss this opportunity and come work as a reach truck driver at Lekkerland in Waddinxveen!

What we offer
- Salary €15,97 per hour (with 6+ months experience)
- Good working atmosphere
- Holiday allowance
- Travel allowance
- Opportunities to grow into team leader
- Chance to get permanent contract

Who you are
As a reach truck driver you can start immediately. In addition it is important that you meet the following requirements:

- You can work in Waddinxveen
- You are  available full-time between Monday till Friday
- You are available for a morning shift between: 7:00 a.m. - 03:00 p.m. (if busy, you are flexible to work overtime)
- You have a valid certificate and experience as a reachtruck driver
- You can work in different departments with different temperatures
- You can communicate in English or Dutch at least at a communicative level

What will you do
As a reach truck driver at Lekkerland, you will end up in a large warehouse. Here you will work with products that are sold by gas stations and kiosks. So there is a nice extensive range of both food and non-food products. Think of chocolate, coffee, sandwiches, pizza and tobacco. As a reach truck driver, you are a real all-rounder. You will have various tasks. You will drive away delivered pallets with goods on the square to the right place in the warehouse. In addition, you will place pallets with products in racks. At quiet moments you will tidy up pallets and/or list driving. Super diverse!

- Transport: wegrijden van geleverenden pallets met goederen op het plein naar de toegewezen locatie in het magazijn.
- Hijsen: van pallets naar de toegewezen stelling locatie.
- Opruimen: tijdens rustige momenten worden pallets opgeruimd en/of lijstrijden voor de orderverzam
